title: Refusing the spinal tap and nursing him at home
summary: Marge refused the spinal tap and took Zutty home despite the hospital's anger, kept him on a salt-free diet with Dr. Newman, though they first ate Chinese food, and Zutty was told not to drink.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

He said, well we'll give him the spinal tap. Well I knew I wasn't going to let them give him no spinal tap. And Zutty said he didn't want to stay. Zutty said, I don't want to stay Marge. And I said, I'm going to take you home.

And I told the doctor I was going to go home and have a big drink.
